name: no-distractions
description: Learn from YouTube. Without the distractions. A distraction-free, learning-focused platform built around YouTube educational content.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n CLIENT,SERVER -c blue,green "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w client && npm run lint -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w client && npm run test -w server
